'''''Calamagrostis arundinacea''''' is a species of [[bunch grass]] in the family [[Poaceae]], native to [[Eurasia]], [[China]] and [[India]].<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/imp01749.htm|author=W.D. Clayton |author2=M. Vorontsova |author2-link=Maria Vorontsova (botanist)|author3=K.T. Harman |author4=H. Williamson|title=Calamagrostis arundinacea|publisher=The Board of Trustees|work=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|Royal Botanic Gardens]]|location=[[Kew]]|accessdate=March 31, 2013}}</ref> Under its synonym ''Calamagrostis brachytricha'' it has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web|title=AGM Plants March 2020 © RHS – ORNAMENTAL |date=March 2020 |website=rhs.org.uk |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/pdfs/agm-lists/agm-ornamentals.pdf |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=11 September 2020 }}</ref>

==Description==
The species is perennial and tufted with short [[rhizome]]s and erect [[culm (botany)|culms]] that are {{convert|60|-|150|cm}} long. Each leaf has a truncate ligule which is {{convert|2|–|4|mm|2}} long, and obtuse. The leaf-blades are {{convert|8|–|50|mm|1|abbr=on}} by {{convert|1.8|–|10|mm|2|abbr=on}}, [[hairless]] and have both a [[scabrous]] surface and an [[Glossary of botanical terms#attenuate|attenuate]] apex. The [[panicle]] has a scaberulous [[Peduncle (botany)|peduncle]] and is lanceolate, open, continuous, and is {{convert|8|–|18|cm|abbr=on}} long by {{convert|1|–|4|cm|1|abbr=on}} wide. Flowers have a pair of [[lodicule]]s and [[Stigma (botany)|stigmas]], and three [[anther]]s which are {{convert|2.4|–|2.7|mm|2|abbr=on}} long. The [[fruit]] is a [[caryopsis]] with an additional [[pericarp]].<ref name=kew/>
